guitar.notes: Wes Borland has a well-documented long-running Ibanez Iceman signature guitar line.

tone.target: tight scooped nu-metal rhythm with chunky palm mutes
tone.profile: tight scooped nu-metal rhythm with chunky palm mutes
tone.summary: A modern metal chain utilizing a powerful distortion/high-gain preamp (RAT-style or Distortion) followed by an aggressive amp model (Recti or UK 800) into a robust 4x12 cabinet, emphasizing tightness and punchy rhythm tones.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain rhythm playing.
Provide a tight boost and slight mid-hump to help the rhythm cut through without sounding muddy.
blocks.gap: While Tube Screamer is ideal, OD 9 serves as the best available high-gain tightening pedal substitute.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the aggressive, high-gain crunch necessary for nu-metal chugs and palm muting.
Simulate the massive, tight, modern high-gain tone required for metal rhythm.
Provide a robust and punchy foundation for the rhythm tone, matching the required 4x12 cabinet feel.
blocks.gap: While Mesa/Marshall cabs are ideal, UK Vintage 4x12 offers the necessary size and aggressive voicing.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the signature scooped mids and tight low end characteristic of nu-metal.
No wah effect needed; the tone must remain dry and aggressive.
Avoid ambient or delay effects to maintain maximum rhythmic tightness and dryness.
Keep the sound dry and punchy; avoid ambient reverb.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better match the desired Mesa-style high gain tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Mesa 4x12 IR (or similar modern metal cab)
proposals.reason: The UK Vintage IR is too British; a Mesa/American style cabinet will better capture the required tight, aggressive nu-metal sound.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased punch and American rock tightness.
